findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement immediately without cause and without paying you for work completed, leaving you uncompensated.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, exposing you to the risk of non-payment after handing over rights.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am reviewing the details and would like to propose a couple of minor adjustments to the relevant clauses before we proceed. - Regarding the clause addressing contract termination, it currently allows for termination without notice and without payment for completed work; I propose updating this so that either party may terminate without cause upon written notice, with the client paying for all services performed up to that date. - Regarding the clause on intellectual property, rights currently transfer upon delivery rather than upon full payment; I propose that all intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverable. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this soon.
